proposal.headline: Add a northwest-plunging anticline followed by eastern Quaternary valley fill
proposal.observation: The target has nested older-bedrock bands running from the northwest corner toward the southeast edge, with a broader blue exposure southwest of the narrow purple core. Yellow cover occupies the northeastern river corridor; the current prediction instead exposes unit 7 everywhere.
proposal.expected_effect: Produce an elongated older-rock core with bands closing toward the northwest, and replace bedrock with unit 8 along the northeastern corridor without folding the young cover.
proposal.program:
strata(levels=[-1.2, -1.05, -0.92, -0.78, -0.5, 0.1], units=[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7])
anticline(x=3.6, y=1.4, azimuth=128, uplift=1.55, dip_ne=40, dip_sw=25, hinge=0.12, nw_length=1.5, se_length=4, plunge_nw=25, plunge_se=0)
deposit(unit=8, x=5.0, y=2.4, azimuth=155, base=-0.025, curvature_cross=0.6, curvature_along=0, slope=0)
erode(level=0)
